items.title: Any form of security through obscurity is fully over
items.text: Any form of security through obscurity is fully over. This barely worked as a method with humans, but just simply is over in a world of autonomous systems that will look through every crevice and try every permutation of attack possible. As a result, years and years of legacy enterprise infrastructure will need to be upgraded, security practices modernized, data pipelines cleaned up, access controls better managed, and much more. Agents will help on the defensive side because they can both accelerate this work and equally simulate the risk vectors. But there’s a long road ahead to prepare for this future. This is also partially why diffusion timelines will take longer than some realize.

items.title: If you feel stuck in your career, stop waiting for clarity
items.text: If you feel stuck in your career, stop waiting for clarity. create it through action. A lot of PMs reaching out for advice tell me they feel stuck as AI rapidly changes their role. They want to get into AI but don’t know where to start and are afraid. This inertia kills clarity…the solution to this is action. Build something, automate a workflow, connect with people who inspire you. Each action gives you experience, feedback and new ideas. Clarity is often the consequence of action. Send this to a friend who needs to hear it.
